findings: Verified: retrospective-plan.ts readSessionSnapshot validates ancestry, unique IDs, parent references, context-edit/compaction targets, tool-result pairing, and pending tool calls before clone derivation.

Verified: index.ts completeRewind revalidates the anchor and label, writes branch metadata before branchWithSummary, and restores prior leaf/clears marker on write failure; reused tool-call IDs across divergent branches remain a scrutiny point, not a confirmed defect.
Verified: continuity-ledger.ts rewindLedger restores snapshot items while retaining maximum revision and nextId from the abandoned state, avoiding lineage rollback.

Verified: retrospective-command.ts validates the source snapshot and complete tool calls before proposal; proposal-command.ts validates plan/source hashes, rechecks source before exclusive wx save with mode 0600. handoff.ts locally deduplicates child IDs during materialization while metadata validation permits repeats; this behavior is not established as a defect.
Verified: auto-navigate limits evaluation to a bounded branch tail and gates anchor/rewind decisions on sent records, exposed anchors, fresh names, and valid focus; invalid output falls back to none.

Verified: descendant-sessions.ts resolves parentSession relative to the file and filters path-linked descendants while rejecting duplicate IDs, cycles, and source changes. continuity-store replay follows active root-to-leaf branch and branch_summary snapshots; malformed entries warn and skip.

Verified: retrospective.ts validateClone rejects duplicate IDs, dangling parents, and compaction/context_edit targets outside ancestry, and checks context projections/runtime state at original-entry checkpoints.

Verified: cloneRetrospectiveSession binds clone creation to preview token, source hashes, and family; stages exclusive files, validates reopened root SessionManager state before hard-link publication, and rolls back staged outputs on failure.
